summary: Two independent R3 reviews and a separate reservation/official-result audit agree that v21/v18 retain the repaired authority-context and DirectoryIdentity foundations, but writer/QualityPass issuance, full-slot topology, held-lock state mutation, S0-to-S6 lifecycle and official archival-result admission remain incomplete or contradictory.

limitations: The consolidated result only records independent read-only findings and does not change the reviewed design.

No product/test/contract/gate/ledger/status/historical-evidence implementation changed; no project-code execution, training, archival replay, budget consumption, PIT certification, M7 or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Define one closed artifact-to-writer-to-effective-identity-to-FD-ACL-to-slot matrix, with a pre-E quality issuer for Bootstrap/QualityPass, archive_acceptor-only E/C/ArchiveAcceptance/S6 publication, replay_supervisor-only P/F/A/B/Q/R/V/S0-S5 work, and child-only ChildReceipt.

Require observed, hash-bound, root/FD-resolved M6EngineeringQualityGatePass bytes and its parsed Bootstrap ref before E construction; no caller-supplied typed ref or ambient artifact lookup may suffice.

Close every authority, policy, namespace, profile, anchor, registry, state, receipt, staging/output and final-index slot under one explicit root-relative normal form with parent identity chains and unambiguous component bases.
Make a non-forgeable held-and-revalidated lock capability mandatory for every R/V/terminal and post-S0 mutation; define the complete S0-to-S6/receipt/output lifecycle and crash/recovery outcomes.

Create a controlled archival launcher and official resolver that accept only context-bound V/S5/ArchiveAcceptance/S6 evidence and explicitly reject raw legacy worker PASS receipts and M6ArchiveSummary as official results.

Reissue architecture and change design, then obtain fresh independent R3 design-review PASS before test design, red tests, implementation, code review, archival replay, M7, CCC/Gate or final-OOS work.
